items.raw_excerpt: Australia charges to a 50-point win over Ireland in the first women's Australian rules international, as a full house is entertained by the thrills and spills at North Sydney Oval.

items.raw_excerpt: Public health nurses have been pulled from other duties in Washtenaw County, MI, to call hundreds of people sick with cyclosporiasis, and try to help them remember everything they ate in recent days.
items.summary_en: Public health nurses in Washtenaw County, Michigan are calling hundreds of people who got sick with cyclospora. They use grocery receipts, food apps, and detailed interviews to help patients remember what they ate. Their goal is to find the common source of the foodborne illness.
items.summary_ko: 미시간주 워슈테노 카운티의 공중보건 간호사들이 다른 업무를 미뤄 두고 장염에 걸린 수백 명에게 전화를 걸고 있다. 환자들이 최근 며칠 동안 무엇을 먹었는지 기억하도록 돕기 위해 영수증, 음식 앱, 자세한 인터뷰를 활용한다. 목표는 식중독의 공통된 원인을 찾아내는 것이다.
items.title_en: Nurses chase Cyclospora using grocery receipts, food apps and detailed interviews

items.raw_excerpt: Lurking at the fringes of electronic music, artists such as Richie Culver, Rainy Miller and Iceboy Violet are confronting the alienation and deprivation of the UK’s north
items.summary_en: A strange music scene called northern gothic is growing in small towns of Yorkshire and Lancashire. Artists like Richie Culver, Rainy Miller and Iceboy Violet sing about hard lives and loneliness in the north of England. They say everyone comes from a place of ordinariness.
items.summary_ko: 노던 고딕이라 불리는 낯선 음악 장면이 요크셔와 랭커셔의 작은 마을에서 자라고 있습니다. 리치 컬버, 레이니 밀러, 아이스보이 바이올렛 같은 음악가들은 영국 북부의 힘든 삶과 외로움을 노래합니다. 그들은 모두가 평범함에서 시작한다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: Northern gothic: the strange music scene born in small-town Yorkshire
items.title_ko: 노던 고딕, 요크셔와 랭커셔의 작은 마을에서 태어난 낯선 음악 장면
items.title_original: ‘Everybody comes from a place of mundanity’: northern gothic, the strange music scene rooted in small-town Yorkshire and Lancashire - The Guardian

items.raw_excerpt: Alors qu’il intervenait pour des fuites d’eau sur toiture, le couvreur a découvert un important problème de charpente ce qui a contraint le maire, Gilles Bidon, à mettre en sécurité un bâtiment situé en plein cœur de Sathonay-Village, inoccupé depuis son acquisition par la commune en juin 2024.
items.summary_en: A roofer found serious roof-frame damage while fixing a water leak. The mayor of Sathonay-Village has closed a communal building in the village center that may collapse. The empty building has been owned by the town since June 2024.

items.raw_excerpt: Segundo moradores, terreno com vegetação alta e lixo tem atraído serpentes, em especial da espécie jiboia. Quatro animais já foram resgatados pela Polícia Ambiental na localidade.
